description.value: The Port Coquitlam Farmers Market is a seasonal outdoor market held at Leigh Square in the heart of downtown Port Coquitlam, operated by the Fraser North Farmers Market Society. It brings together local farmers, artisan food producers, and makers offering fresh produce, handcrafted goods, and small-scale food products. The market also features live music and community activities, making it a lively resupply stop for cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities area.

address.value: 2253 Leigh Square Pl, Port Coquitlam, BC V3C 3B8
